title: Portal: name a packages token
summary: The step after Create token on Account → Packages and before the token exists: a Label field prefilled from the browser and renamed for the machine, what the token can do and when it expires, and that other tokens keep working.
compare: Opens over Account → Packages (the page stays dimmed); a small dialog with the title 'New packages token'.
Label is the one field, focused, here typed as 'Work laptop'; its hint gives the browser's suggestion ('Mac · Safari') and why to name the machine (to tell tokens apart).

Three fixed facts, each led by its glyph: 'Packages only', 'Expires in 90 days, on Jan 5, 2027', 'Reaches DJDL, Diceroll and any product you get a license for later'. No scope, product or expiry picker.
'Your other tokens keep working.' under it; Cancel (outline) and the primary 'Create token', which leads to packages.portal-token.
Phone: the kit's bottom sheet with the buttons pinned full width, the primary on top.

designReview.reviewer: 4 UX designers, triaged by a lead designer
designReview.verdict: Spacing and copy trimmed per the multi-review triage; see findings.

findings.issue: Sentences repeat a fact said in the sibling dialog.
findings.resolution: Helper 'Name the machine, to tell tokens apart'; 'Expires Jan 5, 2027 (90 days)'; 'Your other tokens keep working' removed (the revoke dialog carries it).
